segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so I was cleaning up the August invoice exceptions and Northlake popped up. Billing tool has them at 54 seats, service-through 7/31, and the CRM activity tab is basically the May 9 admin training and nothing after.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Is the exception because seat count doesn't match the quote, or because there's no quote attached?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: No quote attached. The last order form in the folder is the $38,880 one, net 30, paid by PO 4416. Finance just needs something to tie the next invoice to before they release it.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. Did they add those six operations seats I saw in the support notes, or are those still trial users?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Still trial in the product admin screen. If they convert, pricing sheet puts them at $60 per seat per month, same tier. No discount approval needed unless they ask for the old 12%.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Let's not overcomplicate it. Build a clean quote for 54, then a second line item for the six optional seats, and send both to deal desk.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. Do you want me to keep the payment terms at net 30? Their AP portal usually pays on day 28, no issues.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Keep net 30, annual billing, standard terms. Put the target go-live for the extra seats as August 15 so implementation isn't guessing.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Okay, I'll package it. If deal desk turns it by three, finance can still get the invoice in tomorrow's batch.
